# Ably

Ably is a real-time messaging platform helping developers build live features, including chat and data synchronization, with global scalability and robust reliability for modern applications

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/ably/.

## Actions

- **Create Ably Channel**: Creates a new channel or retrieves an existing channel in ably.
- **Delete Channel Subscription**: This tool allows you to unsubscribe devices or clients from push notifications for specific channels.
- **Get Ably Service Time** (read-only): This tool retrieves the current server time from ably's service in milliseconds since the epoch.
- **Get Application Stats** (read-only): This tool retrieves your application's usage statistics from ably.
- **Get Channel Details** (read-only): This tool retrieves metadata and details for a specific channel in ably.
- **Get Channel History** (read-only): This tool retrieves the message history for a specified ably channel.
- **Get Channel Presence History** (read-only): This tool retrieves the history of presence messages for a specified channel in ably.
- **List Push Channel Subscriptions** (read-only): This tool retrieves a list of all push notification channel subscriptions.
- **Publish Message to Channel**: This tool will allow users to publish a message to a specified ably channel using a post request.
- **Query Batch Presence** (read-only): This tool enables querying the presence states of multiple channels in a single api request.
- **Query Batch Presence History** (read-only): This tool enables querying presence history for multiple channels in a single api request.
